name: Sannidhya Sahoo

key_achievements: Led end-to-end backend architecture and deployment of NilEasy, a GST NIL return filing platform, building the complete backend infrastructure using FastAPI.

Engineered scalable REST APIs, workflow automation systems, and chatbot integrations, enabling businesses to complete GST filings in under 5 taps instead of navigating multiple forms and 30+ minutes of manual effort.
Reduced average GST filing time from 30+ minutes to under 2 minutes through conversational automation.
Integrated WhatsApp and Telegram Business APIs to deliver a conversational filing experience, processing 200+ GST filings and serving 250+ users within the first 1.5 months of launch.
Collaborated directly with founders on product strategy, onboarding workflows, and user analytics to drive adoption and guide feature development.

projects: IDHard – privacy-preserving digital identity platform using Zero-Knowledge Proofs, SD-JWTs, and Polygon
CompliBot – AI-powered GST filing assistant on WhatsApp/Telegram with OCR and AI
Blockchain Land Registry – decentralized land registry DApp on Ethereum/Polygon
